Package me.kaiyan.missilewarfare.items

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    CustomItems
    Registers all custom Slimefun items, recipes, and researches for the MissileWarfare addon.
    GuideBook
    A Slimefun item that provides an in-game written book guide for MissileWarfare features and mechanics.
    ManPad
    A hand-held man-portable air defence system (MANPAD) Slimefun item that allows players to lock onto and fire at incoming missiles.
    Mine
    A Slimefun item representing a landmine that disguises itself as the block it is placed against and detonates when a player walks over it.
    MissileClass
    Represents the statistical attributes of a missile type.
    MissileItem
    A Slimefun item representing a missile that displays stats in its lore and prevents melee combat usage.
    MissileRadar
    A Slimefun block that detects nearby missiles and outputs a redstone signal when one is within range.
    PlayerList
    A Slimefun item that manages a named list of players, used for missile launcher targeting permissions via the Conversation API.
